exposure: Pregnancy complications (Normal pregnancy, pre-eclampsia, HELLP syndrome)
outcome: Cerebrospinal fluid concentrations of tau and phospho-tau-181 protein
cohort: 90 pregnant women electively assigned for regional anaesthesia during pregnancy or for Caesarean section.
finding: Phospho-tau-181 protein concentrations correlated with placental function, suggesting altered neuronal factor expression during pregnancy may affect placental development.
